## v1.1

- Add live overview of batch sending status.
- Reorganize keypad UI.
 
## v1.0

- Store a single remote or a group of serials in one file.
- Import serials from Dooya .sub captures.
- Add serials by hand as six hex digits.
- Wildcard digits (*) that expand to full ranges.
- Channels 0 to 15 with master address support.
- Per serial channel format (standard and mask).
- Roller and tilt modes, with jog in tilt.
- Adjustable TX Count (1 to 5 frames per tap).
- Disable serials without removing them.
- External CC1101 radio support.
- Save, rename and delete remotes with unsaved change tracking.
- Overwrite prompt when saving over an existing file.
- Cancel a transmission with Back.
- Bundled Defaults remote seeded on first launch.
